## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Olesa de Montserrat, Spain. It starts at Aeri de Montserrat, C-55, 15, 08691 Monistrol de Montserrat, Barcelona. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Aeri de Montserrat cable car round-trip ticket (up & down).

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Discover the breathtaking beauty and rich heritage of Montserrat with a round-trip ticket for the Aeri de Montserrat cable car.
>
> Ride the iconic cable car up Montserrat in just five minutes, traveling 1,350 meters at an average speed of 5 m/s. As you ascend inclines of up to 45%, enjoy spectacular panoramic views of the surrounding landscape and the monumental Rosary of the Virgin.
>
> Once at the top, explore Montserrat at your own pace. Discover the facade of the Benedictine monastery, founded in the 11th century.
